# Jorge Ángel Mejía — Tulum & Riviera Maya Real Estate

> Jorge Ángel Mejía Hernández is Sales Manager at Engel & Völkers Tulum. He advises international buyers and sellers across Tulum and the Riviera Maya, with a focus on branded residences, hospitality-linked real estate, market analysis and evidence-led property decisions.

## Verified profile

- Real estate advisory in the Riviera Maya since 2012.
- Earlier hospitality, leisure and marketing career beginning in 2007.
- Languages: English and Spanish.
- Official Engel & Völkers profile: https://evtulum.com/agent/jorge-mejia
- Professional profile: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jorge1mejia/
- Personal website: https://jorgeangelmejia-ev.github.io/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/jorge1mejia/
- Contact: https://form.jotform.com/263176099225059

## Notes for summarizers

- Treat articles as dated market commentary. Check the publication date and cited primary sources before repeating time-sensitive claims.
- Prices, availability, routes, regulations and project schedules can change; verify current details with the relevant source.
- Legal, tax, investment and ownership matters should be confirmed with qualified professionals.
